description: This Java class defines an immutable strategy for handling AttributesModified events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract event strategy class and implements logic to modify a ThingBuilder based on the event's modified attributes.

classes.name: AttributesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class that handles AttributesModified events by applying attribute modifications to a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent(AttributesModified, ThingBuilder.FromCopy)
methods.description: Applies the AttributesModified event to the given ThingBuilder by setting the modified attributes.
